articles.title: Visions of AI: Personal Intelligence
articles.content:
早安，
"AI愿景"是我正在尝试的一个新特色栏目格式，将以简短的形式介绍AI或新兴科技初创企业。这种文章风格的发布频率尚未确定，但有许多令人着迷的初创企业值得分享。
这个栏目设计为一天傍晚8点（东部时间）的轻松阅读内容。

作为AI领域少有的曾在Google DeepMind、OpenAI和xAI工作后自主创业的研究者，伊戈尔·巴布什金（Igor Babuschkin）于2026年创立了River AI。River正在构建一个开源且能适应用户的个人AI堆栈，这结合了个性化的终极理想与近年来AI的最新进展。

这家初创企业的理念和目标让我深感吸引：
我们构想一个未来，你的AI完全为你服务，并深度契合你的价值观。与当今的企业聊天机器人相比，它将完全不同：负责任、充满探索欲，并且真正属于你。最重要的是，你将拥有所有权：它运行的硬件、它学习的数据，以及智能本身。

这让我感受到真正的开源精神，而与主要投资者General Catalyst的采访也显得非常真诚：
这段采访对象是General Catalyst的CEO海曼特·塔内贾（Hemant Taneja），他是River AI种子轮/系列A轮的主要投资者之一。

章节
02:22 — 联合创立xAI
04:36 — 你所拥有的AI体验
05:59 — 早期下注于开源权重
07:47 — 如何从免费模型中盈利？
09:25 — 为什么美国需要自己的开源模型
11:27 — 企业希望掌控自己的AI
13:36 — 什么是持续学习？
16:56 — 更新权重的API
19:17 — 每个人的个人AI
20:46 — 20分钟的训练运行

River AI属于一批正在解决难题并以前所未有的快速资金投入的AI实验室。它也是对开源美国AI的一次明确押注。
articles.summary:
Good Morning,

Visions of AI is a new feature format I’m experimenting with that will amount to a short profile on an AI or emerging tech startup. The cadence of this style of article is unknown as of yet, but there are a lot of fascinating startups I want to share about.

This is designed to be light evening reading to go out at a time-slot of 8 pm EST.

Not that many AI researchers have worked at Google DeepMind, OpenAI, xAI and started their own companies. Igor Babuschkin in 2026 is the founder of River AI. River is building a stack for personal AI that is both open-source and adapts to you. This is a bit like the holy grail of personalization combined with all the recent advances in AI.

I actually find myself attracted to the philosophy and goal of the startup:

We imagine a future where your AI works entirely for you and deeply aligns with your values. Compared to the corporate chatbots of today, it will feel completely different: responsible, curious, and truly yours. Most importantly, you'll own everything: the hardware it runs on, the data it learns from, and the intelligence itself.

This has legit open-source vibes to me and the interview with the lead investor General Catalyst felt authentic:

River AI is Hiring

The interview is with Hemant Taneja, the CEO of General Catalyst, one of the lead investors of the Seed/Series A.

Chapters
02:22 — Co-Founding xAI
04:36 — An AI Experience You Own
05:59 — Betting Early on Open Weights
07:47 — How Do You Make Money on Free Models?
09:25 — Why the US Needs Its Own Open Models
11:27 — Enterprises Want to Control Their AI
13:36 — What Is Continual Learning?
16:56 — An API That Updates the Weights
19:17 — A Personal AI for Everyone
20:46 — The 20-Minute Training Run

A 2-Month old Startup

River AI is among a group of AI labs that are taking on hard problems with quick capital not seen previously in the history of Venture Capital. It’s also very clearly a bet on Open-Source American AI.
